question: In a certain code language, 'BOOM' is coded as 'YLLN'. What is the code for 'MOVE' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BOOM' is coded as 'YLLN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3232e7dabb5ab2f932d0933c5d2e2f6c77217e0a38d19c3e1bc29c107ce20ab.png] 

Similarly, for '**MOVE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a36b1e5c6e8cc45d683910c94fa8d0ece052190e4b15490fbd4b3a78d59ca51.png] 

So, 'MOVE' will be coded as '**NLEV**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
